en.Situation: For my final-year app, the list screen froze for about three seconds whenever the network was slow.
en.Task: I wanted the screen to open immediately, and to keep the data honest about being old.
en.Action: I cached the last response locally, showed it with a last-updated label, and added a test that opens the screen with no network.
en.Result: The screen opened instantly, and the label stopped me from showing stale data as if it were fresh.
en.vague: The app was slow sometimes on bad connections.
en.exaggerated: I built an offline-first app that no student had managed before.
en.no_data: After the change the screen opened without freezing.

zh.Situation: 畢業 project 個 app，網絡慢嘅時候列表畫面會凍結大約三秒。
zh.Task: 我想畫面即刻開，同時要老實顯示資料係舊嘅。
zh.Action: 我把上次 response cache 落本機，顯示時加 last updated 標籤，再寫一個冇網絡都開得到畫面嘅測試。
zh.Result: 畫面即刻開，而個標籤令我唔會把舊資料當新。
zh.vague: 連接差嘅時候個 app 有時好慢。
zh.exaggerated: 我做咗一個學生從未做到嘅 offline-first app。

en.Situation: Before an iOS release, the TestFlight group found that the form rejected a phone number with a space in it.
en.Task: I owned that form, and I had to fix it without breaking the numbers that already worked.
en.Action: I normalised the input by stripping spaces, added tests for four Hong Kong number formats, and asked the testers to retry.
en.Result: All four formats passed, and the release went out one day late instead of a week.
en.vague: Testers found a problem with the phone number field.
en.exaggerated: I fixed every input validation issue in the app.
en.no_data: After the fix the form accepted the numbers.

zh.Situation: iOS 發佈前，TestFlight 測試組發現表格會拒收有位空格嘅電話號碼。
zh.Task: 我負責個表格，要修好但唔可以弄壞本來正常嘅號碼。
zh.Action: 我先去除空格再驗證，加四個香港號碼格式嘅測試，再請測試同事重試。
zh.Result: 四個格式全部通過，發佈遲一日而唔係遲一個星期。
zh.vague: 測試同事發現電話欄位有問題。
zh.exaggerated: 我修好咗 app 所有輸入驗證問題。
zh.no_data: 修好之後表格接受得到啲號碼。

en.Situation: The backend team renamed two fields in the visit API, and our app started showing blank addresses on three hundred devices.
en.Task: I had to stop the bleeding quickly, and then agree with the backend team how the next change would be handled.
en.Action: I released a client that accepts both field names, then asked for a version path so future changes could be made safely.
en.Result: Blank addresses stopped within a day, and the next API change had a version path instead of a rename.
en.vague: An API change broke part of the app.
en.exaggerated: I forced the backend team to change their whole API policy.
en.no_data: After the release the addresses showed again.

zh.Situation: 後端同事把到訪 API 兩個欄位改名，我哋 app 喺三百部機開始顯示空白地址。
zh.Task: 我要快速止血，然後同後端團隊講好下次改動點處理。
zh.Action: 我出一個同時接受兩個欄位名嘅版本，再要求加版本路徑令日後改動安全。
zh.Result: 一日內空白地址停止，而下次 API 改動有版本路徑而唔係改名。
zh.vague: API 改動搞壞咗 app 一部分。
zh.exaggerated: 我逼到後端團隊改晒佢哋成個 API policy。
zh.no_data: 出新版本之後地址顯示返。

en.Situation: Four years in, an ERP companion app had to be shipped to a client in six weeks and the client's IT team kept changing the login requirement.
en.Task: I had to freeze one login design, and get the client's IT lead to confirm it in writing.
en.Action: I wrote a one-page comparison of three login options with effort and risk, and ran a thirty-minute call with the client's lead.
en.Result: The client chose single sign-on with a two-week buffer, and the app shipped without a login change afterwards.
en.vague: The login requirement kept changing and it was difficult.
en.exaggerated: I designed the client's entire identity platform.
en.no_data: In the end we agreed one design and shipped.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，一個 ERP 配套 app 要在六星期內交貨，而客戶 IT 不停改登入要求。
zh.Task: 我要定住一個登入設計，並要客戶 IT 主管書面確認。
zh.Action: 我寫一頁比較三個登入方案嘅工作量同風險，同客戶主管開三十分鐘會。
zh.Result: 客戶揀 single sign-on 並留兩星期 buffer，app 之後冇再改登入。
zh.vague: 登入要求不停改，好難做。
zh.exaggerated: 我設計咗客戶成個身份驗證平台。
zh.no_data: 最後議定一個設計並出貨。

en.Situation: In my internship, the visit log list scrolled badly on an older phone with four hundred records.
en.Task: I was asked to look at it, and I had to confirm the cause before changing anything.
en.Action: I profiled the screen, found every row rebuilt its own date formatter, and moved to one shared formatter with a recycling list.
en.Result: Scroll time dropped from about two hundred milliseconds per frame to under twenty on the same phone.
en.vague: The list was slow on older phones.
en.exaggerated: I rewrote the app's whole architecture.
en.no_data: After the change scrolling was smooth.

zh.Situation: 實習時，到訪紀錄列表喺舊電話有四百筆時捲動好卡。
zh.Task: 有人叫我睇下，我要先確認原因才改任何嘢。
zh.Action: 我 profile 個畫面，發現每行都自己建一個日期 formatter，於是改成共用一個 formatter 同回收式列表。
zh.Result: 同一部機上每格捲動由大約二百毫秒跌到廿毫秒以下。
zh.exaggerated: 我重寫咗 app 成個架構。

en.Situation: A user with enlarged system font size reported that the check-in button was pushed off screen.
en.Task: I owned the layout, and I had to fix it for large text without redesigning every screen.
en.Action: I moved the button into a scrolling container, set a minimum touch height, and tested three font scales with screenshots.
en.Result: The button was reachable at every scale, and two other screens got the same small fix.
en.vague: The layout broke when the font size was bigger.
en.exaggerated: I made the app fully accessible for every disability.
en.no_data: After the change the button was reachable.

zh.Situation: 有同事把系統字體調大之後，簽到按鈕被推出畫面之外。
zh.Task: 我負責個排版，要令大字體都用到，但唔想重做每個畫面。
zh.Action: 我把按鈕放入可捲動容器，設最小點擊高度，再用截圖測三個字體比例。
zh.Result: 每個比例都按得到，另外有兩個畫面亦做同樣細修。
zh.exaggerated: 我令 app 對所有殘疾都完全無障礙。

en.Situation: Five years in, field staff kept entering visits offline and losing them when the phone restarted.
en.Task: I had to make the queue survive a restart, and explain the limit honestly to the operations lead.
en.Action: I moved the queue to local storage with a status per entry, then asked operations how many visits a staff member makes in a day.
en.Result: No visits were lost in the next month, and we set a clear limit of two hundred queued entries.
en.exaggerated: I built a fully offline ERP for the field team.
en.no_data: After the change visits stopped being lost.

zh.Situation: 做咗五年，前線同事離線輸入到訪紀錄，電話重啟就唔見。
zh.Task: 我要令個 queue 重啟都撐得住，並老實向營運主管講清楚上限。
zh.Action: 我把 queue 移去本機儲存，每筆有狀態，再問營運同事一日做幾多單。
zh.Result: 之後一個月冇再漏單，我哋亦定明兩百筆嘅上限。
zh.exaggerated: 我為前線團隊做咗一個完整離線 ERP。

en.Situation: In my first job, our app crashed on launch for about two per cent of users and the crash log only said null.
en.Task: I was asked to find the pattern, and I had to stop guessing from my own phone.
en.Action: I grouped crashes by device model and OS version, then reproduced it on the two models that matched.
en.Result: It was one font call unsupported on an older Android version, and after a guard the crash rate went to zero.
en.exaggerated: I found and fixed every crash in the app.
en.no_data: After the fix the crashes stopped.

zh.Situation: 第一份工，我哋 app 大約百分之二用戶一開就 crash，而 crash log 只寫住 null。
zh.Task: 我要找出模式，而唔可以再靠我自己部電話去估。
zh.Action: 我按機型同 OS 版本分組 crash，再喺吻合嘅兩個型號上重現。
zh.Result: 係一個舊 Android 唔支援嘅字體呼叫，加防護之後 crash 率變零。
zh.exaggerated: 我搵出並修好晒 app 所有 crash。
zh.no_data: 修好之後 crash 停咗。

en.Situation: At an agency, two clients wanted the same booking screen with different payment flows, and we had one month.
en.Task: I had to share the code without making a setting that nobody could reason about later.
en.Action: I extracted the flow into two implementations of one interface, with a test per flow and a note on which client uses which.
en.Result: Both clients launched on the same build, and a third client was added later with no change to the shared screen.
en.vague: Two clients wanted slightly different versions of the same screen.
en.exaggerated: I designed a framework the agency now sells as a product.
en.no_data: In the end both clients launched from the same code.

zh.Situation: 喺 agency，兩個客戶想要同一個 booking 畫面但唔同付款流程，而我哋得一個月。
zh.Task: 我要共用代碼，但唔想整出一個日後冇人講得明嘅設定。
zh.Action: 我把流程抽成同一個 interface 嘅兩個實作，每個流程一個測試，再寫明邊個客用邊個。
zh.Result: 兩個客用同一個 build 上線，第三個客後來加入都冇改共用畫面。
zh.vague: 兩個客想要同一個畫面嘅少少唔同版本。
zh.exaggerated: 我設計咗一個 agency 依家當產品賣嘅框架。
zh.no_data: 最後兩個客都用同一套 code 上線。

en.Situation: Six years in, the app's cold start took four seconds on mid-range phones and the growth team blamed it for drop-off.
en.Task: I had to find where the time went before agreeing to any rewrite.
en.Action: I measured the start-up phases, found two SDKs initialising on the main thread, and moved both behind first screen.
en.Result: Cold start fell to 1.4 seconds, and the drop-off the growth team measured improved in the next release.
en.vague: The app started slowly and growth was unhappy.
en.exaggerated: I made our app the fastest in the category.
en.no_data: After the change the app started faster.

zh.Situation: 做咗六年，app cold start 喺中階機要四秒，growth 團隊話係流失原因。
zh.Task: 我要先找出時間花喺邊，然後才同意任何重寫。
zh.Action: 我量度啟動各階段，發現兩個 SDK 喺 main thread 初始化，於是把兩者推到首屏之後。
zh.Result: cold start 跌到 1.4 秒，growth 量度嘅流失喺下個版本有改善。
zh.vague: app 啟動慢，growth 唔滿意。
zh.exaggerated: 我令 app 成為同類最快。

en.Situation: On a six-month contract, the QA person and I disagreed about whether a slow list was a defect or a device problem.
en.Task: I wanted an answer we could both accept, not a vote.
en.Action: I measured the same build on three devices, put the timings in the ticket, and asked her to add hers.
en.Result: Two devices were fine and one was slow, so the ticket became a device-specific defect with evidence.
en.vague: We disagreed about whether something was a bug.
en.exaggerated: I proved the QA person had tested it wrongly.
en.no_data: In the end we agreed it was a defect on one device.

zh.Situation: 做半年合約，QA 同事同我就「慢列表係 bug 定機問題」有分歧。
zh.Task: 我想要一個雙方都接受嘅答案，而唔係投票。
zh.Action: 我用同一個 build 喺三部機量度，把時間寫入 ticket，再請佢加上佢嘅數據。
zh.Result: 兩部機正常、一部慢，於是 ticket 變成有證據嘅特定機型 defect。
zh.vague: 我哋對一樣嘢係唔係 bug 有分歧。
zh.exaggerated: 我證明咗 QA 同事測錯。
zh.no_data: 最後大家都同意係某一部機嘅 defect。

en.Situation: At a retailer, the app sent a notification at nine in the evening because a time zone was hard-coded.
en.Task: I owned notifications, and I had to fix the schedule and tell the affected customers honestly.
en.Action: I moved to device-local scheduling, tested three time zones, and drafted the apology note with the marketing lead.
en.Result: No further late-night notifications were sent, and the note went to the affected group the same day.
en.vague: Notifications were sent at the wrong time.
en.exaggerated: I rebuilt the entire notification service by myself.
en.no_data: After the fix the notifications came at the right time.

zh.Situation: 喺一間零售商，app 因為時區寫死，喺晚上九點發通知。
zh.Task: 我負責通知，要修好排程，並老實同受影響客戶講。
zh.Action: 我改成按裝置本地時間排程，測三個時區，再同 marketing 主管一齊寫道歉訊息。
zh.Result: 冇再喺深夜發通知，訊息亦當日發畀受影響群組。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人重建咗成個通知服務。
zh.no_data: 修好之後通知時間正常。
